TC1.Test Description: Validates falling-edge interrupt behavior on a subset of GPIO inputs and confirms status, group interrupt, and system interrupt clear operations.
TC1.Remarks: Either GPIO0 or GPIO1 must be defined to enable the corresponding platform interrupt. Pad values are driven via a dedicated memory-mapped register.
TC1.Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the GPIO interrupt in the system controller via INTR_EN1.
2) For each GPIO from 8 to 39, configure falling-edge detection using the per-GPIO register (gp0_intr2_intr_en1).
3) Configure the GPIO IO control registers for the groups to set input mode and falling-edge detection.
4) Enable the group interrupt via INTR1_INTR_EN1.
5) Drive the pad control register to produce falling transitions on selected pads and wait for the interrupt.
6) On interrupt, read the per-GPIO status/data register and verify the input state reflects the transition.
7) Verify the group interrupt status in INTR1_INTR_STS1 shows the expected bit set.
8) Clear the per-GPIO raw interrupt status via the per-GPIO register and verify the clear took effect.
9) Verify INTR1_INTR_STS1 is cleared.
10) Clear the system interrupt status via RAW_STCR1 and confirm it is cleared.
TC1.Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) The input state read from the per-GPIO register reflects the falling transition; pass if the input indicates active.
2) The raw interrupt indication for the GPIO is present; pass if the status shows the interrupt asserted.
3) The group interrupt register shows the bit corresponding to the active GPIO; pass if the bit is set.
4) After writing the clear value, the per-GPIO raw status is cleared; pass if the status no longer indicates an interrupt.
5) The group interrupt status becomes zero after handling; pass if the register reads as cleared.
6) The system interrupt raw status is cleared; pass if the status bit is deasserted after the clear.
